body:
For each fixed cutoff K>1 and floor b<1, explicitly modify the audited balanced tilt to obtain critical tail moment at most one in every dimension, exact total critical moment at most two, and actual transfer gap tending to zero. A probability-dependent coefficient controls the fixed tail, and dilution toward one enforces the total budget without increasing that tail.

This closes the finite-cutoff tau=1 obstruction left separate from unit302's asymptotic sharpness. K=1 is not addressed. Group with units300-302; no standalone paper, originality claim, numerical grade or formal verification. Judges precede the candidate. Depends on PR248 and PR249 and must merge only after both unchanged sources are integrated; its own new files are judges303.txt and finite-tail303A.txt. Separate analytical audit and required checks remain gates.
